Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              wei.tao@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-08-20
-- Theme Domain：       Anti-fraud 日志数据策略feature - dwd 层
-- Description:         https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-54753
-- Data Granularity:    
-- Change Log:
--********************************************************************--

drop table if exists risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di (
    flow_no STRING,
    platform_user_id STRING,
    app_id STRING,
    scene_id STRING,
    af_result STRING,
    req_time BIGINT,
    szdf STRING,
    bssid STRING,
    device_brand STRING,
    device_model STRING,
    app_version STRING,
    system_type STRING,
    app_type STRING,
    reg_phone STRING,
    client_ip STRING,
    ip_city_name STRING,
    gpshex6 STRING,
    gpshex7 STRING,
    gpshex8 STRING,
    gpshex9 STRING,
    gpshex10 STRING,
    gpshex11 STRING,
    location_status STRING,
    gps_country STRING,
    gps_city STRING,
    gps_province STRING,
    gps_district STRING,
    gps_subdistrict STRING,
    is_spl_reactivate STRING,
    is_bcl_reactivate STRING,
    is_scl_reactivate STRING,
    is_reactivate STRING,
    end_result STRING,
    ip3 STRING --ip3 use
) 
COMMENT ''
PARTITIONED BY (
    grass_date STRING,
    process_date STRING
) 
STORED AS parquet
tblproperties
(
    "orc.compress" = "zstd"
)
location '${HDFS_PATH}/dwd/dwd_risk_reg_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di/grass_region=${grass_region}';

ADD JAR hdfs://${IDC_NAMESPACE}/projects/credit/hdfs/udf/hive-udf.jar;

drop temporary function if exists format_time; 
create temporary function format_time as 'com.shopee.seamoney.udf.FromTimeStamp';

WITH workflow_result AS (
    SELECT
        flow_no,
        CASE
            WHEN coalesce(
                    get_json_object(output, '$.CheckResult'),
                    get_json_object(output, '$.checkResult')
                ) = '1'
            THEN 'pass'
            ELSE 'reject'
        END AS final_result
    FROM risk.dwd_risk_${reg}_af_credit_workflow_di
    WHERE grass_date >= cast('${ds_t_3}' as string) --考虑晚到
      AND grass_date <= cast('${ds}' as string) 
      AND scene_id IN (10035,10025,10045,10055,10075,10084,10005,10095,10105)
          AND app_id IN ('kredit','spj','chp','2w','tl','spjup','motorloan')
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_spl_reactivate = '1' AND app_id = 'kredit')
              OR (is_bcl_reactivate = '1' AND app_id = 'spj')
              OR (is_scl_reactivate = '1' AND app_id = 'spjup')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS is_reactivate,
        CONCAT(SPLIT(client_ip,'\\.')[0],'.',SPLIT(client_ip,'\\.')[1],'.',SPLIT(client_ip,'\\.')[2]) AS ip3
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            a.flow_no,
            a.platform_user_id,
            app_id,
            scene_id,
            a.final_result AS af_result,
            b.final_result AS end_result,
            cast(date(format_time(req_time,UPPER('${reg}'))) as string) AS req_dt, --as partition
            req_time,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.extension_process_data.sz_dfp.device_id') AS szdf,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.extension_process_data.sz_dfp.bssid') AS bssid,
            device_brand,
            device_model,
            app_version,
            system_type,
            app_type,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.PhoneNo') AS reg_phone,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.client_ip') AS client_ip,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.extension_process_data.ip_city_info.ip_city_name_v2') AS ip_city_name,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex6') AS gpshex6,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex7') AS gpshex7,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex8') AS gpshex8,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex9') AS gpshex9,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex10') AS gpshex10,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.GpsHex11') AS gpshex11,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.status') AS location_status,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.address.levelZero') AS gps_country,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.address.levelOne') AS gps_city,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.address.levelTwo') AS gps_province,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.address.levelThree') AS gps_district,
            get_json_object(extension,'$.CommonHeader.location.address.levelFour') AS gps_subdistrict,
            coalesce(get_json_object(extension, '$.is_spl_activated'), '0') AS is_spl_reactivate,
            coalesce(get_json_object(extension, '$.is_cashloan_activated'), '0') AS is_bcl_reactivate,
            coalesce(get_json_object(extension, '$.is_sellerloan_activated'), '0') AS is_scl_reactivate,
            network_type,
            cellular_type
        FROM risk.dwd_risk_${reg}_strategy_final_result_merge_di a
        INNER JOIN workflow_result b
            ON a.workflow_flow_no = b.flow_no
        WHERE scene_id IN (10034, 10024, 10044, 10054, 10074, 10104, 10094, 10026, 10004, 10085)
          AND app_id IN ('kredit','spj','chp','2w','tl','spjup','motorloan')
          AND grass_date >= cast('${ds_t_3}' as string) --考虑晚到
          AND grass_date <= cast('${ds}' as string) 
    )
)

insert overwrite table risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di partition (grass_date, process_date)
select 
    flow_no,
    platform_user_id,
    app_id,
    cast(scene_id as string),
    cast(af_result as string),
    req_time,
    szdf,
    bssid,
    device_brand,
    device_model,
    app_version,
    system_type,
    app_type, 
    reg_phone,
    client_ip,
    ip_city_name,
    gpshex6,
    gpshex7,
    gpshex8,
    gpshex9,
    gpshex10,
    gpshex11,
    location_status,
    gps_country,
    gps_city,
    gps_province,
    gps_district,
    gps_subdistrict,
    cast(is_spl_reactivate as STRING),
    cast(is_bcl_reactivate as STRING),
    cast(is_scl_reactivate as STRING),
    cast(is_reactivate as STRING),
    end_result,
    ip3,
    req_dt as grass_date,
    '${ds}' as process_date
from final_result
;

msck repair table risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di;
refresh table risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di;
